description: The robots dialect of AGSC-06-18 gets its input at rc.6: one User-agent group with `Disallow: /` per product token of site.tdm_crawlers[], in the order the configuration states them, before the `User-agent: *` group, and no `Disallow` for any token the list does not name — so a fetch made on a person's behalf and a search crawler stay invited. Derivation: the groups are a function of the configured list alone; the whole file's bytes are NOT asserted, because no rule pins them (the same reading as build-0012 under AGSC-06-01 as amended at rc.5). Second case: a node that publishes tdm-reservation 1 with an empty list is AGSC-E202 at build, because the Content Use Terms text AGSC-06-18 pins by hash tells the reader that the robots signals carry the reservation.
note: added 2026-09-22 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
